Last verified 2026-05-28.
_definition: Each entry marks a CVFR reporting point where pilots are expected to switch ATC frequencies because the point sits on (or at) a sector / CTR / TMA boundary. The chart annotation may be on the boundary line itself rather than directly at the point — the dataset records the *point of change*, not the chart-text position.
_NOTE: TYONA was initially retracted in d4ef4a1 because the chart annotation 'פלוטו מע.' labels the Pluto/Palmachim sector-boundary line rather than the TYONA dot itself. Restored after clarification: TYONA is the reporting point at which pilots cross that boundary, so it IS a comm-change point under the dataset's point-of-change semantics (see _definition). Lesson: chart-text position does not always coincide with the point being annotated; record the point where pilots act.
